items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And Mike Holloway. And they all had brand new instruments.

ctx.x: And Mike Holloway. And they all had brand new instruments. Uh, very fine instruments, too. Very polished and all that. And they had little funny hats to put on, and, and they did things, you know. They put on funny hats, and then they'd, uh, uh, one boy played, uh, accordion. He swapped over and played accordion, uh, loud and wrong, but he played accordion, squeeze box, you know. And, uh, people were eating that up. And here we were with a seasoned band. And, uh, I had always advocated you had to do a little…
Just fell out on the floor right now.
